Class Entry

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.tt.Entry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Described, Named, Titled
Direct Known Subclasses:
Database.Listable
public class Entry extends Object implements Titled
An entry is a publicly available object that has a name, title, and description.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

  • Constructor Details

    • Entry

      public Entry(String name, String title, String description)
      Constructs an entry from its name, title, and description.
      Parameters:
      name - the unique system name for this element, which is primarily used internally by the server
      title - a short natural language phrase for this element that will be displayed to users
      description - a short natural language statement explaining the details of this element that will be displayed to users
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the name is null

    • Entry

      public Entry(Titled titled)
      Constructs an entry using the meta-data of another object.
      Parameters:
      titled - the object whose name, title, and description will be copied
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the object's name is null
